AltText.description:
Description slot. Empty and ``needs_review`` unless a person supplies it; a model
draft (optional, off by default) is never verified.
AltText.title: AltText

Box.description: A rectangle on one physical page, in PDF points (unrotated crop box, y down).
Box.title: Box

BoxNode.description:
Text set apart from the running text: a sidebar, a coloured callout box or a card,
with its own units in reading order.
BoxNode.title: BoxNode

Caption.description: A caption that is not linked to a figure or table (review).
Caption.title: Caption

Continuation.description:
A link to the next (``continues_to``) or previous (``continues_from``) piece of the same
logical paragraph, item, entry or table across a page or column break.
Continuation.title: Continuation

Equation.description:
A display equation. ``output`` says what the default rendering uses; an image
fallback always carries an alt-text slot.
Equation.title: Equation

FigureText.description: A caption, credit or text inside the figure (embedded text), with its unit id.
FigureText.title: FigureText

FontStyle.description: What the book's fonts were learned to be (per book, from flags and names).
FontStyle.title: FontStyle

Footnote.description:
A note set apart from the running text (footnote area). Its marker in the text is a
superscript span; the link between them is not decided (flagged).
Footnote.title: Footnote

Furniture.description: A running head or foot, folio or production mark: kept, outside ``content``.
Furniture.title: Furniture

IndexDivider.description: A letter heading inside an index ("A", "B"...): neither a heading nor an entry.
IndexDivider.title: IndexDivider

InlineSpan.description:
Inline meaning over ``text[start:end]`` of its unit (``start == end`` only for a math
insertion point: drawn inline math read at that place).
InlineSpan.title: InlineSpan

LineJoin.description:
A decision at a source line end inside ``text`` (the ``"\n"`` at ``at``): a break
hyphen removed (``join``/``soft_join``: the hyphen at ``hyphen_at`` and the line end
vanish when read), a real hyphen kept (``keep``: the line end vanishes), or a word split
without a hyphen (``word``: the line end vanishes). Line ends without a record read as a
space.
LineJoin.title: LineJoin

LinkTarget.description:
An internal link target: a physical page, and the unit at the target point when one
holds it.
LinkTarget.title: LinkTarget

ListItem.description:
A list item or entry; the marker is structure, not text. ``children`` holds nested
lists (and sub-entries) that directly follow it.
ListItem.title: ListItem

ListNode.description:
One run of consecutive items of a list on one page (a ``segment``); segments of the
same list share ``list_id`` and link with ``continues_from``/``continues_to``.
ListNode.title: ListNode

Locator.description: An index or glossary locator: offsets in the entry text and the resolved target.
Locator.title: Locator

Marker.description: A list marker as structure: its printed text, kind and ordinal value.
Marker.title: Marker

PageMarker.description: The start of a physical page in reading order, with its printed label.
PageMarker.title: PageMarker

PersonName.description:
A parsed personal name (client profile option, off by default); the printed text is
always kept in the entry.
PersonName.title: PersonName

Provenance.description: Which stages produced the unit and a short evidence summary.
Provenance.title: Provenance

ReviewItem.description: One thing a person should look at: what, where, why and what to do.
ReviewItem.title: ReviewItem

RunInfo.description: Not part of the content hash.
RunInfo.title: RunInfo

SourceRefs.description:
Where a unit's text comes from: layout line ids, and span ranges for parts of lines
(``span``: 16-hex span id; ``start``/``end``: original code points, half-open).
SourceRefs.title: SourceRefs

SourceRun.description:
A slice of existing text in a source line split by suppression; no text copy.

Reassemble slices by (page, line), then (position, source_start) to recover the
ledger's token boundaries even when part of a token was hidden.
SourceRun.title: SourceRun

Suppressed.description:
Source text that is not content, and why: nothing disappears silently. Text outside
the TrimBox is the ledger's explicit discard; hidden text was retained by the ledger and
is dropped from content here with its evidence.
Suppressed.title: Suppressed

TableText.description: A table's title or note: a unit next to the table (``unit``) or lines inside it.
TableText.title: TableText

TextContent.description: Text of one unit: the source text, never edited, with spans and join decisions.
TextContent.title: TextContent

TextFragment.description: Text inside a table cell that is not a whole unit (lines or parts of lines).
TextFragment.title: TextFragment
